args.command:
cd /var/home/bmosher/pilot-gen45-work/run_13 && python3 -c "
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_DOWN, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_CEILING
d = Decimal('-1.005')
print('Original:', d)
print('ROUND_HALF_DOWN:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_DOWN))
print('ROUND_HALF_UP:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('ROUND_FLOOR:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR))
print('ROUND_CEILING:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
# What about -1.015?
d2 = Decimal('-1.015')
print()
print('Original:', d2)
print('ROUND_HALF_DOWN:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_DOWN))
print('ROUND_HALF_UP:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
"
